quotes.title: HD 16175
quotes.card: HD 16175 is a 7th magnitude G-type star with temperature about 6,000 K located 196 light-years away in the Andromeda constellation.
quotes.introduction: This star is only visible through binoculars or better equipment; it is also 3.3 times more luminous, is 1.34 times more massive, and has a radius 1.66 times bigger than the Sun.
